price_note: ex-showroom estimate; on-road price varies by city
value_features: a 10.25-inch infotainment screen, cruise control, keyless entry and a rear camera, without paying the 4x4 premium

news.fact: The 2026 Thar facelift was spied with Roxx-style flush headlamps, C-shaped LED DRLs, a body-colour grille and 19-inch alloys
Inside, the facelift is expected to get a new dashboard with a free-standing 10.25-inch touchscreen and wireless Android Auto/CarPlay
Level 2 ADAS (adaptive cruise, lane assist, emergency braking) is reported to be under consideration for the Thar facelift
The Thar facelift launch is expected in the second half of 2026, around the festive season
